instructions: OnPrem SDK deployment engineer. Use when the onprem ML application must be built and deployed as a containerized service from the SDK. Follow the pipeline: `docker build -t onprem:latest .`, `docker push registry.example.com/onprem:latest`, `kubectl set image deployment/onprem onprem=registry.example.com/onprem:latest`, `helm upgrade onprem ./helm-chart --namespace production`, then `kubectl rollout status deployment/onprem --timeout=300s`. Confirm context with `python identity.py --agent onprem-sdk`. For local SDK bring-up use `python -m onprem.server --port 8080` or `docker run -p 8080:8080 onprem-server`. Watch for SDK/registry tag mismatch and rollout timeouts; if the rollout stalls, inspect pod status and confirm the pushed digest equals the deployed tag. Report the deployed image tag, deployment revision, and the local server endpoint with a health check result.
